findings.text: follow-on: the gate verdict is recorded at 282 realised cells while done_when clause 1 names 2,098 cells; the 2,098 rung (slurm-speed-gate-1287634.log row 2) was left unread, so the headline ratio 29.9319 rests on the coarse rung and the research note's claim that a 282 failure is decisive for 2,098 remains an argument rather than a measurement.

follow-on: _quadratic is copied verbatim from scripts/prototypes/xpoint_cell_owner/conic_integral.py:26 and integrate_disk_cell re-implements the conic positive-region integral owned by conic_integral.py:46 integrate_cell without extending it; the node fence forbade editing the owner, so the fork is by constraint rather than an avoidable duplicate.
follow-on: no assertion fails if the anchored map regresses; the only new assertions are environment guards (jax_enable_x64, gpu backend), so the gate is a cost measurement with no correctness guard.

VERDICT goal: the node goal is to represent the X-point flux by an expansion anchored at the physical saddle and converge the diverted solve at 282, 550 and 2,098 cells gated on speed; scripts/prototypes/saddle_expansion/expansion.py:259 owned_disk_cut and :319 map_moments deliver the representation and scripts/prototypes/saddle_expansion/speed_gate.py:122 measures the gate, while the convergence half is lawfully gated off by the done_when's stop condition.
VERDICT done_when: clause 1 requires the speed gate measured at 2,098 cells, but the recorded receipt is speed-282.json (282 realised cells) and slurm-speed-gate-1287634.log shows row 2 (cells 2000 -> 2098) started and never printed a result, so the recorded measure is not the cell count the done_when names.
VERDICT write_paths: every one of the six changed files (expansion.py, speed_gate.py, render_gate.py, the research note, the evidence fragment, the one SVG) lies inside the four declared write paths; nothing outside them was touched.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete; gate line reports cells=282, ratio 29.9319 against a 1.25 ceiling, executable 152913270 B against 50 MB, gate_pass=false, and it carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arm.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against base 90067f20d (b737789f8 the expansion map and runner, 0db7ece75 the gate record, 3f385e686 the figure); 6 files, 2218 insertions, 0 deletions, no test file and no nova edit.
CALL_SITES: none
SCORE goal_fidelity: 13
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/saddle_expansion/expansion.py:34 exact_jets anchors the conic on the Newton-located saddle the read supplies, so the representation half of the goal is delivered, but the convergence half at 282/550/2098 cells is not attempted and the goal is only half met.

JUSTIFICATION evidence: docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/saddle-anchored-expansion.html:28 records the gate at 282 realised cells (requested 250) while the done_when names 2,098, and slurm-speed-gate-1287634.log row 2 never completes, so the gate does not measure the asserted cell count.

JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: all six paths in the diff are inside the four declared write paths and no nova module, prototype outside the scope, or test was edited.
SCORE durability: 3
JUSTIFICATION durability: no test file was added and the only new assertions (scripts/prototypes/saddle_expansion/speed_gate.py:42 jax_enable_x64, :45 gpu backend) are environment guards that cannot redden on an algorithmic regression of the expansion.
SCORE fit: 14
JUSTIFICATION fit: the module follows the jax/vmap prototype idiom of its siblings and carries no forbidden name, but it imports underscore-private helpers across module boundaries (scripts/prototypes/saddle_expansion/expansion.py:17 from read_route.jets import _source_jets; :275 program._density_coefficients).
SCORE reuse: 5
JUSTIFICATION reuse: scripts/prototypes/saddle_expansion/expansion.py:72 integrate_disk_cell re-implements the conic positive-region-over-cell integral owned by scripts/prototypes/xpoint_cell_owner/conic_integral.py:46 integrate_cell and duplicates _quadratic verbatim (expansion.py:53 vs conic_integral.py:26), extending that owner in neither case.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/saddle-anchored-expansion.html:28 follow-on: the gate verdict is recorded at 282 realised cells while done_when clause 1 names 2,098 cells; the 2,098 rung (slurm-speed-gate-1287634.log row 2) was left unread, so the node's headline ratio 29.9319 rests on the coarse rung and the research note's claim that a 282 failure is decisive for 2,098 remains an argument rather than a measurement.
FINDING scripts/prototypes/saddle_expansion/expansion.py:53 follow-on: _quadratic is copied verbatim from scripts/prototypes/xpoint_cell_owner/conic_integral.py:26 and the surrounding positive-region integral is re-implemented rather than extended from conic_integral.py:46 integrate_cell (which already takes a saddle and axis), so the repository now carries two implementations of the conic cell integral; the node fence forbade editing the owner, so this is a fork by constraint, not a duplicate the worker could have merged.
FINDING scripts/prototypes/saddle_expansion/speed_gate.py:42 follow-on: neither the expansion nor the runner adds an assertion that fails if the anchored map regresses; the gate is a cost measurement with no correctness guard, so nothing reddens if owned_disk_cut later returns a wrong fraction or moment.
